epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase accurate feature readiness tracking from 9/13 to 13/13
requirements: R1: Correct the feature readiness and deliverable detail calculation to prevent false regression drops

slices.title: Patch project readiness metric calculation
slices.jtbd: When implementing the readiness metric fix for this epic, I want to patch the calculation logic, so that the correct readiness state is reflected
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend observer script evaluates project state, When calculating feature readiness, Then it correctly returns the terminal status instead of regressing to 9/13.
Given the metric service checks deliverables, When calculating deliverable detail, Then it correctly evaluates to the completed state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false deliverable regressions from 5 to 0
